# betterado_serviceendpoint_github_enterprise (Resource)

Manages a GitHub Enterprise Service Connection within Azure DevOps.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# GitHub Enterprise service connection using a Personal Access Token (PAT).
resource "betterado_serviceendpoint_github_enterprise" "example" {
  project_id            = var.project_id
  service_endpoint_name = "my-github-enterprise"
  github_enterprise_url = "https://github.example.com"
  personal_access_token = var.github_enterprise_pat
  description           = "GitHub Enterprise connection via PAT"
}

variable "project_id" {
  type = string
}
variable "github_enterprise_pat" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project.
- `service_endpoint_name` (String) The Service Endpoint name.
- `url` (String) The GitHub Enterprise server URL.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The Service Endpoint description.
- `oauth_configuration_id` (String) The OAuth2 configuration ID.
- `personal_access_token` (String, Sensitive) The GitHub Enterprise personal access token.

### Read-Only

- `authorization` (Map of String) Specifies the authorization scheme.
- `id` (String) The ID of the service endpoint.
